Indian vlogger highlights Russian prices for daily goods

An Indian vlogger shared observations on the prices of everyday items, specifically water and bananas, in Russia. The vlogger expressed surprise at the costs, suggesting that India might be a more economical option for such goods. This content gained attention online, with viewers reacting to the reported prices.
